terms.name: whorl
terms.definition: The funnel of rolled young leaves at the top of a grass plant, from which new leaves emerge. From above, the plant's centre.

terms.name: leaf collar
terms.definition: The pale band where the leaf blade meets the sheath; the counting unit of the corn V-stage system. Not resolvable from a drone.

terms.name: ligule
terms.definition: A membrane or fringe of hairs at the collar of a grass leaf; the key that separates grass species on the ground. Millimetre scale; never resolvable from a drone.

terms.name: spike
terms.definition: The pointed coleoptile of an emerging grass seedling before the first leaf unrolls (corn VE).

terms.name: alternate, in one plane
terms.definition: Leaves borne one per node, alternating sides, all in one vertical plane (corn, sorghum). From above the plant is a line of leaves, not a disc.

terms.name: lanceolate
terms.definition: Long and narrow, widest below the middle, tapering to a point (corn leaves after the first, pigweed first true leaves).

terms.name: rounded tip
terms.definition: A blunt, oval leaf tip; the corn first leaf has one, every later leaf is pointed.

terms.name: lobed
terms.definition: Leaf margin cut into rounded or pointed lobes (giant ragweed 3 to 5 lobes, cocklebur shallow lobes).

terms.name: heart-shaped
terms.definition: Broad leaf with a notched base (velvetleaf, morningglory).

terms.name: rosette
terms.definition: Leaves radiating from a short stem near the ground; from above a compact disc or star.

terms.name: erect
terms.definition: Growing upright; projected area from above smaller than the leaf area.

terms.name: prostrate or decumbent
terms.definition: Lying along the ground or rising only at the tip (crabgrass, purslane, yellow foxtail); from above a flat mat with large projected area for its height.

terms.name: tuft
terms.definition: A tight cluster of grass shoots from one point; from above a small irregular star of narrow leaves.

terms.name: canopy closure
terms.definition: The stage at which leaves from neighbouring rows meet over the alley, so the ground between rows is no longer visible from above.

terms.name: projected area
terms.definition: The area a plant covers seen straight from above; what a nadir image measures. Smaller than leaf area for erect plants.

terms.name: alley
terms.definition: The ground between two crop rows; where row-crop weed cover is measured from above.

terms.name: row band
terms.definition: The strip along a row line taken to hold the crop; vegetation inside it is not counted as between-row weed cover.
